MAINTENANCE
Oct 27, 2026
SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - OCTOBER 29, 2026

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 1:00 PM CET / 11:00 PM AEDT). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 8 hours, concluding around 1:00 PM PDT (4:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CET / 7:00 AM AEDT October 30).

Times:

Thursday, October 29, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 1:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
CET (UTC +1): 1:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEDT (UTC +11): 11:00 PM - 7:00 AM October 30

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v271.5.0.
Monthly Windows Update.
Full list of changes and updates will be available here after the maintenance is complete.

items.title: maintenanceOct 23, 2026v.271 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Oct 23, 2026
V.271 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.271 - MapleStory x Frieren: Beyond Journey's End update:

KNOWN ISSUES:
We have identified an issue where using Group Chairs may intermittently cause problems. Group Chairs will be disabled until the next maintenance.
Kazax's Energy Fragments and Inspector Boxes obtained from the Ride or Die event could not be opened even though the items had not expired.
For affected players, these items will be compensated in a future maintenance.
MacOS users who have updated to macOS 27 Golden Gate are unable to access MapleStory through Steam.
We advise players to download and install MapleStory directly from the Nexon Launcher, which will prompt the Rosetta install needed to access the game. Once Rosetta is installed, MapleStory can be accessed from Steam as normal.
RESOLVED ISSUES:

October 23, 2026

Resolved an additional issue where Grandis Daily Quests did not grant Sol Erda rewards upon choosing not to collect the Grandis Symbol when quests were completed individually.
Affected players will receive the missing Sol Erda rewards during a future maintenance.

October 21, 2026

Resolved an issue where the Night Troupe event’s ‘Daily Quest Event Buff Lv. 4’ effect did not apply when using the Symbol Express Pass.

October 20, 2026

Text updated to “Claim Designer EXP” in the Activate Virtual Training mini-game to clarify that Designer EXP must be claimed.

October 13, 2026

Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter the Yeti’s Night event map.

October 12, 2026

Resolved an issue where Grandis Daily Quests did not grant Sol Erda rewards upon choosing not to collect the Grandis Symbol.
Affected players will receive the missing Sol Erda rewards during a future maintenance.

September 30, 2026

Resolved an issue where the Information Viewer '?' button in the [Night Troupe] Mesotron-S Project event displayed a 404 error.

September 21, 2026

Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to pending Meso Market Transactions.
Meso or Maple Points for affected players will be distributed at a later date. 

September 17, 2026

Resolved an issue where Night Lord and Ren characters would disconnect when entering Phase 3 of Kaling.
Resolved an issue where the Symbol Selector Coupon's item description incorrectly displays as "Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2" instead of x1.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap from Challenger World.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to World Leap due to an error stating "You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first."
Resolved an issue where Princess No would not attack.
Resolved an issue where the Guild Board UI contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where Sacred Symbol Selectors obtained from the Weekly Guild Castle Missions could not be used.
Resolved an issue where the Frieren NPC text titles contained Spanish text.
Resolved an issue where after using Mercedes's Spirit of Elluel skill, the cooldown would not decrease after using a linked skill.
Resolved an issue where Demon Avenger characters interacting with Mastema during a Job Advancement quest could cause the client to disconnect.
Resolved an issue where Sol Hecate would stop attacking after using Phlegethon while Styx was bound to the Terms and Conditions.
Resolved an issue where the client would sometimes disconnect when using Star Cores on Gollux Gear in Veritas.
Resolved an issue where the Guiding Stars link skill would not properly apply when logging in.
Resolved an issue where the Power Cycle in Phase 2 of First Adversary message contained untranslated text.
Resolved an issue where the Legion buff item icons incorrectly displayed "Union" instead of "Legion".
Resolved an issue where the Animation toggle effects were reversed in the Enhance UI.
Resolved an issue where Erel characters could not add the Tree of Stars skill to their Buff Favorites UI.
Resolved an issue where the Random Mimic Box obtained from the 'Adventure with Frieren's Companions' event displayed an incorrect description.
Resolved an issue where characters who have not completed Monster Park Extreme are unable to use the Monster Park Extreme Express Pass Ticket.

September 18, 2026

Resolved an issue where Erel Light characters were unable to start the 2nd Job Advancement quest. Players who were unable to complete the 2nd Job Advancement can do so through the Maple Administrator.

September 10, 2026

Resolved an issue where Glowing Cubes were not working as intended when used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v271 Patch. Potential resets using Cubes has been re-enabled.
Glowing Cubes used on Hats with Legendary Potential after the v.271 patch and before Potential resets were temporarily disabled have been distributed via the Gift Drop and can be claimed for three weeks. Glowing Cubes are untradable and have a 30-day duration.
Resolved an issue where the key binds would overlap when assigning a new key bind to quickslot UI.
Resolved an issue where players would disconnect from client when using Ascent skills in Black Mage.

September 9, 2026

Tallahart Fantasia Check-In Event
Players who were unable to check in at 55 and 56 check-ins during the Fantasia Finale week will have their missed rewards distributed via Maple Administrator following the maintenance on September 9, 2026.
Resolved an issue where some players were unable to purchase a Kinetic Pass.
The Kinetic event has been extended until September 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM UTC and can be accessed by talking to Maple Administrator.
items.bodyZh:
维护
2026年10月12日
V.271 已知问题

已知问题部分主要关注对游戏和社区产生重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看，以获取这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题以及可能新增问题的相关信息。

以下为 v.271 - 冒险岛 x 葬送的芙莉莲 更新中的已知问题和已解决问题列表：

已知问题：
我们已确认使用组队椅子时可能间歇性出现问题。组队椅子将在下次维护前禁用。
从 Ride or Die 活动中获得的 Kazax's Energy Fragments 和 Inspector Boxes 即使未过期也无法打开。
对于受影响的玩家，这些物品将在未来的维护中补偿。
已更新至 macOS 27 Golden Gate 的 MacOS 用户无法通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
我们建议玩家直接从 Nexon Launcher 下载并安装冒险岛，这将提示安装访问游戏所需的 Rosetta。安装 Rosetta 后，即可正常通过 Steam 访问冒险岛。
已解决问题：

2026年10月12日

修复了 Grandis 日常任务在选择不收集 Grandis Symbol 时不给予 Sol Erda 奖励的问题。
受影响的玩家将在未来的维护中收到缺失的 Sol Erda 奖励。

2026年9月30日

修复了 [Night Troupe] Mesotron-S Project 活动中信息查看器“？”按钮显示 404 错误的问题。

2026年9月21日

修复了部分玩家因待处理的枫币市场交易而无法进行世界飞跃的问题。
受影响玩家的枫币或枫叶点数将在稍后发放。

2026年9月17日

修复了夜行者和 Erel 角色在进入 Kaling 第三阶段时断开连接的问题。
修复了符号选择券的物品描述错误显示为“Sacred Symbol Selector Coupons x2”而非 x1 的问题。
修复了部分玩家无法从 Challenger World 进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了部分玩家因错误提示“You haven't checked the results of your previously registered Mystic Frontier Champion Lineup yet. Check the results first.”而无法进行世界飞跃的问题。
修复了 Princess No 不攻击的问题。
修复了公会公告板 UI 包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了从每周公会城堡任务获得的 Sacred Symbol Selectors 无法使用的问题。
修复了 Frieren NPC 文本标题包含西班牙语文本的问题。
修复了使用 Mercedes 的 Spirit of Elluel 技能后，使用链接技能时冷却时间不减少的问题。
修复了 Demon Avenger 角色在职业进阶任务中与 Mastema 互动时可能导致客户端断开连接的问题。
修复了 Sol Hecate 在 Styx 绑定至 Terms and Conditions 时使用 Phlegethon 后停止攻击的问题。
修复了在 Veritas 中对 Gollux 装备使用 Star Cores 时客户端有时会断开连接的问题。
修复了 Guiding Stars 链接技能在登录时无法正确应用的问题。
修复了 First Adversary 第二阶段 Power Cycle 消息包含未翻译文本的问题。
修复了联盟增益物品图标错误显示为“Union”而非“Legion”的问题。
修复了增强 UI 中动画切换效果反转的问题。
修复了 Erel 角色无法将 Tree of Stars 技能添加到增益收藏 UI 的问题。
修复了从“Adventure with Frieren's Companions”活动中获得的 Random Mimic Box 显示错误描述的问题。
修复了未完成怪物公园极限的角色无法使用怪物公园极限快速通行证的问题。

2026年9月18日

修复了 Erel Light 角色无法开始第二次职业进阶任务的问题。无法完成第二次职业进阶的玩家可通过 Maple Administrator 完成。

2026年9月10日

修复了 v271 补丁后，对传说潜能帽子使用 Glowing Cubes 时未按预期生效的问题。使用魔方重置潜能已重新启用。
在 v.271 补丁后、潜能重置暂时禁用前，对传说潜能帽子使用的 Glowing Cubes 已通过 Gift Drop 发放，可在三周内领取。Glowing Cubes 不可交易，有效期为 30 天。
修复了为快捷栏 UI 分配新键位时键位重叠的问题。
修复了在黑魔法师中使用 Ascent 技能时玩家与客户端断开连接的问题。

2026年9月9日

Tallahart Fantasia 签到活动
在 Fantasia Finale 周期间无法在第 55 和 56 次签到进行签到的玩家，其缺失的奖励将在 2026年9月9日维护后通过 Maple Administrator 发放。
修复了部分玩家无法购买 Kinetic Pass 的问题。
Kinetic 活动已延长至 2026年9月15日 晚上11:59 UTC，可通过与 Maple Administrator 对话进入。

items.title: maintenanceClassicOct 22, 2026[Completed] Unscheduled Maintenance - October 22, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 2 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Oct 22, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED MAINTENANCE - OCTOBER 22, 2026

[Updated 10/22 at 2:14 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 2 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing an unscheduled maintenance starting on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 1:00 PM PDT (4:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CEST / 7:00 AM AEDT October 23). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 3:00 PM PDT (6:00 PM EDT / 12:00 AM CEST October 23 / 9:00 AM AEDT October 23).

Times:

Thursday, October 22, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 1:00 PM - 3:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 10:00 PM - 12:00 AM October 23
AEDT (UTC +11): 7:00 AM October 23 - 9:00 AM October 23

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

Due to the larger than expected number of players following the Grand Launch, we are implementing additional optimizations and preventative measures to help maintain service stability.
Added the Debt System. Please read the full details HERE.
Resolved an issue where the color Green was not a selectable option when using the Signature Eye Color Coupon.
Resolved an issue where accounts that have not met the trade requirements (reaching Lv.15 and waiting 24 hours) could not drop Kerning City Party Quest coupons and passes.
